title: One Earthquake Tilted the Whole Earth's Axis 6.5 Inches

scenes.text: One earthquake tilted the entire Earth's axis.
On March 11, 2011, a magnitude 9.0 earthquake hit Japan.
NASA calculated it shifted Earth's axis by about six and a half inches.
It also made the day about 1.8 millionths of a second shorter.
A GPS station near the epicenter moved 13 feet.
A shake on one coast. A tilt for the whole planet.

description:
The magnitude 9.0 Japan earthquake of March 11, 2011 shifted Earth's axis by about 6.5 inches and shortened the day by 1.8 millionths of a second.
A GPS station near the epicenter moved 13 feet.
Did you feel it?
